llm_justification.summary: This market tracks a low-probability tail event: Trump announcing resignation by end-2026. A sharp, credible rise in its implied probability would signal an acute US leadership/political crisis, mapping to risk-off in equities (SPY down) and a safe-haven bid in gold (GLD up), with USD weakness. But the base rate is tiny, the market is thin and noisy, and absent a confirming newswire catalyst most moves are false positives. Confidence is low and directional magnitudes modest unless a genuine crisis materializes.
key_assumptions: A material prediction-market probability move actually occurs and is observable before public news
A resignation-odds spike reflects genuine leadership instability rather than manipulation or noise
Equities and gold retain their historical risk-off/haven relationships to US political shocks
failure_modes: The market move reverts within hours with no news — pure noise/manipulation in a thin market
The event/news was already public and fully priced, so proxies do not move on observation
Proxies (SPY, gold) are only weakly and diffusely exposed to this specific political event
Resignation announcement, even if credible, could be read as reducing uncertainty (orderly succession), muting or reversing the expected risk-off reaction
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
